subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The new software update brought quite a few improvements in the __transactions.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"deals"** refers to business transactions or agreements, especially those involving the buying and selling of goods or services. (सौदे)

 
 
• **Example:** The company finalized deals with multiple suppliers to ensure the steady delivery of raw materials.
 
 
 
• The word **"transactions"** is used to describe the process of conducting business or financial exchanges. Here, "deals" acts as a synonym for "transactions." (लेन-देन)
 
 
• **Example:** All transactions are processed securely through our encrypted payment gateway.
 
 
 
• Thus, the use of the word **"deals"** appropriately substitutes the underlined segment in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Interplay** (अंतरक्रिया): The way in which two or more things have an effect on each other.

 
 
• **Example:** The interplay of light and shadow created a beautiful effect in the photograph.
 
 
 
• **Interpretation** (व्याख्या): The action of explaining the meaning of something.
 
 
• **Example:** Her interpretation of the poem offered a fresh perspective on its themes.
 
 
 
• **Intralingual** (अंत:भाषीय): Something that occurs within the same language, such as paraphrasing or rewording.
 
 
• **Example:** Intralingual translation is often used in teaching language nuances to beginners.
 
 

2f:T956,

The correct answer is option 1.</st
